about: The web search providers `instafy web search` may use, and in which order (`chains`). A provider whose key is not set in the space (`key_env`, added through the secret-request card) is skipped; the first one left answers. `request` says where a search goes: an https `url` (GET with `query` values, or POST with a JSON `body`), and `auth` the header that carries the key (with `prefix`, such as "Bearer "). A key is only ever sent to the host of its own entry's `url`. Values may use {query}, {site} (the `site_filter` with {host} filled in, or nothing), {count}, {lang} and {country}; a value whose placeholder is not given is left out. `results` names where the result list is in the answer (`list`, a dotted path) and each result's `title`, `url` and `snippet`; `where` keeps only the items whose fields have these values. `daily_limit` is the most searches a day with one space's key. Results are never cached (`cache.allowed` is false): search only finds links, and Octo cites the pages it reads. Never add a parameter that asks for page text (`extra_snippets`, `summary`, `extract`). A chain is a list asked in order until one provider answers, or {"mode": "all", "providers": [...]} to ask each one (`reference-search`: Wikipedia, Wikivoyage and the official websites Wikidata records, which need no key). A provider without a key may put {lang} first in its host (with `defaults.lang`), and a result's `url` or `source` may be an https template of the result's fields. A value writes a literal brace as {{ or }}, and {query:sparql} writes the query inside a SPARQL string. A space switches a provider off with its own copy of this file, {"schema": "instafy.search-providers@1", "off": ["wikidata-official-site"]}; a copy can do nothing else. Never add Nominatim: its usage policy bars use as a generic geocoder by platforms like this one. Changing provider is an edit here plus a fixture test, not code.

key_request.description: Brave Search API key for Octo's web searches. Everyone in this space can search with this key, up to {daily} searches a day. Brave bills the key's owner.
Kagi Search API key for Octo's web searches. Everyone in this space can search with this key, up to {daily} searches a day. Kagi bills the key's owner.

query.query: SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?itemDescription ?website WHERE {{ SERVICE wikibase:mwapi {{ bd:serviceParam wikibase:endpoint "www.wikidata.org"; wikibase:api "EntitySearch"; mwapi:search "{query:sparql}"; mwapi:language "{lang}". ?item wikibase:apiOutputItem mwapi:item. }} ?item wdt:P856 ?website. SERVICE wikibase:label {{ bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "{lang},en". }} }} LIMIT {count}
